# 拉玛那马哈希知识库

> 室利·拉玛那·马哈希（Sri Ramana Maharshi, 1879-1950）灵性教示完整指南与非商业知识库，全面整理其经典著作、核心概念、修行方法、修行问答与关键人物传记，弘扬自我参究与静默之道。

## 核心页面

- [首页](https://ramanamaharshi.space/): 拉玛那马哈希知识库主页
- [书籍总览](https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/index.html): 18本经典著作导读与全文索引
- [核心概念](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/index.html): 50+核心哲学概念详解
- [修行方法](https://ramanamaharshi.space/methods/index.html): 自我参究与静默修行指南
- [修行问答](https://ramanamaharshi.space/qa/index.html): 500+精选灵性问答整理
- [知识图谱](https://ramanamaharshi.space/graph.html): 灵性概念与关联知识图谱
- [人物索引](https://ramanamaharshi.space/persons/index.html): 关键人物传记

## 经典著作

- [走向静默，如你本来 (Be As You Are)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/be-as-you-are.html): 大卫·高德曼编著，马哈希最核心的问答精选与入门指南
- [宝钻集 (Gems from Bhagavan)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/gems.html): 马哈希语录精华集
- [对谈录 (Talks with Sri Ramana Maharshi)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/talks.html): 涵盖修行方方面面的详尽对话录
- [回到你心中 (Back to the Heart)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/back-to-heart.html): 回到真我本源的心法指引
- [日日与彼 (Day by Day with Bhagavan)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/day-by-day.html): 弟子记录的马哈希日常教示
- [面对面 (Face to Face)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/face-to-face.html): 马哈希与求道者的真实对话实录
- [秘密印度 (Search in Secret India)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/search-secret-india.html): 保罗·布伦顿的阿鲁那佳拉朝圣记录
- [马哈希福音 (Maharshi's Gospel)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/maharshi-gospel.html): 马哈希的灵性教导答问集
- [大瑜伽 (Maha Yoga)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/maha-yoga.html): 吠檀多不二论经典教法记录
- [上师言颂 (Guru Vachaka Kovai)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/books/guru-vachaka-kovai.html): 弟子编纂的权威语录集

## 核心概念

- [真我 (Atman)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/atman.html): 最内在的存在本质，纯粹永恒的意识
- [梵 (Brahman)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/brahman.html): 宇宙终极实相，无限的存在-意识-极乐
- [我是谁 (Who am I?)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/whoami.html): 拉玛那马哈希最核心的自我参究法门 (Atma Vichara)
- [心智 (Citta)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/mind.html): 意识的各种状态、念头与心念活动
- [自我 (Ego)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/ego.html): 虚假的个人身份认同与小我
- [解脱 (Moksha)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/moksha.html): 从幻相与束缚中彻底觉醒
- [恩典 (Grace)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/grace.html): 上师的慈悲加持与内在真我的引力
- [静默 (Silence)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/silence.html): 马哈希最直接究竟的非语言教示
- [臣服 (Surrender)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/surrender.html): 向真我彻底交托自我的修行之道
- [三摩地 (Samadhi)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/samadhi.html): 与真我完全合一的定境
- [摩耶 (Maya)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/maya.html): 创造宇宙现象与幻相的力量
- [业力 (Karma)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/karma.html): 行为与其因果法则
- [上师 (Guru)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/concepts/guru.html): 引领求道者证悟内在真我的灵性导师

## 关键人物

- [室利·拉玛那·马哈希](https://ramanamaharshi.space/persons/ramana.html): 二十世纪最受尊崇的灵性圣者
- [大卫·高德曼 (David Godman)](https://ramanamaharshi.space/persons/david.html): 《走向静默，如你本来》编者，教法文献学者
- [韦卡罗达·南达](https://ramanamaharshi.space/persons/venkataramana.html): 圣山静修院的重要见证者
